svg.title: Tatawwu Bahrain — project design specification
svg.text: Six MongoDB collections · Field, Type, Options · Crow's-foot relationships
TATAWWU' / BAHRAIN / ENGLISH / MERN + JWT + CLOUDINARY
Each parent is exactly one. A circle means zero is allowed; a fork means
User.username and User.password exist in the starter. Profile/role fields and all other
models are planned. Password stores a hash only.
Compound unique: Registration { volunteerId, campaignId }; Favorite {
userId, campaignId }. Neither reference is individually unique.
Only never-published draft/rejected campaigns without registrations can be deleted. Cancellation and admin removal preserve participation history. Saved unavailable campaigns expose no hidden
details. ObjectId references and role/ownership checks are enforced by Express.
Read with sheet 02 for embedded schemas, enum values, Cloudinary media and Bahrain defaults.
